################################################################################
Purpose of script: To fit brms models to all the studies
################################################################################

# Set up
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("fun_ampphi.R")
source("fun_checkgaps.R")
```

```{r}
# Read in the waic (only models that converged)
waic_df <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waic.rds")) %>%
  filter(dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08", "seallsero_s08"))
waic_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waicbest.rds")) %>%
  filter(dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08", "seallsero_s08"))
```

# Read in data and assess gaps and missing data ====================================================
```{r}
all_datagaps <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagaps.rds"), dir = "", {
  # Define models converging that have a sine function 
  df_converged <- filter(waic_df, dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08", "seallsero_s08"), 
                       mod_out == "imm", str_detect(mod_name, "cs")) 
  # Per model
  sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
    # Select the model 
    dat_mod <- filter(df_converged, mod == x)
    sens <- case_when(dat_mod$dat == "semeth_s08" ~ "semeth",
                      dat_mod$dat == "seallsero_s08" ~ "seallsero", 
                      .default = "")
    # Read in data
    dat_raw <- readRDS(paste0(dirs$modfit, "/data", sens, "_brms_", dat_mod$pat[[1]], "_v", 
                              dat_mod$vac[[1]], "_s08.rds"))
    # Create clu in the data 
    if(!str_detect(x, "csi")) {
      dat_raw <- mutate(dat_raw, clu = NA) 
      } else {
      dat_raw <- rename(dat_raw, clu = all_of(filter(df_converged, mod == x)$reg[[1]])) %>%
        mutate(clu = as.character(clu))
      }
    # Identify gaps and missing data 
    dat_gap <- expand.grid(vac_week_v1 = 1:52,
                           clu = unique(dat_raw$clu),
                           imm_name = str_remove_all(str_subset(names(dat_raw), "imm_val_s1"), 
                                                     "imm_val_s1|_anti_|_")) %>%
      # Create df of total values per week
      left_join(dat_raw %>%
                  group_by(vac_week_v1, clu) %>%
                  summarise(tot = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
                  group_by(clu) %>%
                  mutate(checkgaps = fun_checkgaps(vac_week_v1)) %>%
                  ungroup(),
                by = join_by(vac_week_v1, clu)) %>%
      select(clu, everything()) %>%
      mutate(clu = str_remove_all(clu, " "),
             imm_name = na_if(as.character(imm_name), ""),
             pi_vac_week_v1 = round(vac_week_v1 * (2*pi/52), digits = 11)) %>%
      group_by(clu) %>%
      mutate(checkgaps_all = replace_na(checkgaps, TRUE),
             checkgaps_all = all(checkgaps_all))
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod")
})
```

# 1. Obtain coefficients and data to give a shape to the seasonality: 
```{r}
# Data: Dates of vaccination and number of individuals per day
# Coefficients: p_cos, p_sin, shape
all_funcos <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefcosine.rds")) %>%
  # Join the shape (only for univariate models)
  left_join(readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefre.rds")) %>%
              filter(param %in% c("shape", "sigma")) %>%
              select(mod, imm_name, param, est) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = est), 
            by = join_by(mod, imm_name)) %>%
  left_join(all_datagaps, by = join_by(mod, clu, imm_name)) %>%
  mutate(funcos = exp(int_mean + (p_cos_mean*cos(pi_vac_week_v1)) + (p_sin_mean*sin(pi_vac_week_v1))),
         tot = replace_na(tot, 0)) %>%
  uncount(weights = tot, .remove = FALSE)

# Read in the real data to compare 
dat_l <- lapply(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"), readRDS)
names(dat_l) <- sub(".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v1|v3)_s08.*", "\\1",
                    str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}")), "s08.rds"))
```

# Function to simulate 
```{r}
fun_simcosine <- function(mod_i) {
  filter(all_funcos, mod == mod_i) %>%
    mutate(funcos_sim = if_else(
      gauss == "gauss",
      rlnorm(n(), meanlog = log((funcos^2) / (sqrt(sigma^2 + funcos^2))),
             sdlog = sqrt(log(1 + (sigma^2/funcos^2)))),
      rgamma(n(), shape = shape, rate = shape/funcos))) %>%
    select(pat, mod, clu, imm_name, vac_week_v1, pi_vac_week_v1, funcos, funcos_sim)
}
```

# Simulate 1 time and compare with the real data 
```{r}
# From the function, simulate 1 time
# No multi, as these are rnorm models
dat_1sim <- sapply(unique(filter(all_funcos, mod_out == "imm", dat == "s08",
                                 mod %in% waic_best$mod_best)$mod), 
                   fun_simcosine, simplify = FALSE)

bind_rows(dat_1sim) %>%
  filter(is.na(funcos_sim))

# Plot the time series
pl_l <- lapply(dat_1sim, function(x) {
    ggplot(data = x, aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = funcos)) +
      geom_point(aes(y = funcos_sim), alpha = 0.1) + 
      geom_point(color = "blue") +
      scale_y_continuous(trans = "log") + 
      facet_wrap(imm_name~clu, scales = "free_y")
})

# Plot the histogram
plhis_l <- sapply(dat_1sim, function(x) {
  x %>%
    mutate(data = "simulation") %>%
    bind_rows(
      dat_l[[unique(x$pat)]] %>%
        select(starts_with("imm_val_s1")) %>%
        pivot_longer(starts_with("imm_val_s1"), names_to = "imm_name", values_to = "funcos_sim") %>%
        mutate(
          imm_name = str_remove_all(imm_name, "imm_val_s1|_anti|_"),
          imm_name = na_if(imm_name, ""),
          data = "real")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = funcos_sim)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
    scale_x_continuous(trans = "log") +
    facet_grid(data~imm_name, scales = "free") + 
    ggtitle(unique(x$pat))
}, simplify = FALSE)
```

# Simulate 100 times and save it 
```{r}
# Decide models to simulate
mod_name_l <- unique((filter(all_funcos, mod_out == "imm", 
                             dat == c("s08", "semeth_s08", "seallsero_s08"), 
                             mod %in% waic_best$mod_best))$mod)

# Save the simulations
walk(mod_name_l, function(x) {
  pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$outputs}/simcosfit/simcos_{x}"), dir = "", { 
    replicate(100, fun_simcosine(x))})
  })
```
